header.title: Supplier invoices
header.intro: The complete invoice work queue. Select any unreviewed invoices to run assurance, then inspect recorded decisions, evidence, and recovery.

summary.line: {{facts}}. Human approvals and citations stay attached to every recommendation.

columns.evidenceHint: How many independent experts corroborated the decision, and how many evidence sources they cited.

batch.tooLarge: Reduce the selection to {{max}} invoices or fewer.
batch.limit: Batch limit {{max}} · up to {{concurrency}} starts at once
batch.outcomes: {{accepted}} started · {{reused}} reused · {{notFound}} not found · {{failed}} failed to start

batchConfirm.guidance: Each newly accepted invoice starts a hosted agent orchestration and may incur usage cost. Active runs are reused automatically. Caldova starts at most {{concurrency}} invoices concurrently and accepts up to {{max}} per batch.

noMatches.title: No invoices match these filters
noMatches.body: Try widening the decision, severity, or supplier filters, or clear them to see the full register.

confidence.uncalibratedTitle: Uncalibrated evidence score; not calibrated decision accuracy.

drawer.olderRun: You're viewing an older run. The current decision is Run {{run}}: {{decision}}.
drawer.footerActive: A new assurance run is in progress.
drawer.footerRerun: A re-run opens a new case. Earlier runs stay in the history.

clauses.title: Contract and policy basis
clauses.empty: No contract or policy basis is attached to this decision. Treat it as unsupported until a reviewer ties it to a clause.
clauses.noCitations: FoundryIQ didn't record clause-level citations for this run. The documents below are the basis on file.

evidence.title: Evidence by source
evidence.clausesListed: Clauses are listed under Contract and policy basis.

copy.failedSelect: Couldn't copy. Select the text instead.

supplier.title: For {{supplier}}
supplier.draftedBy: Drafted by {{author}} on {{date}}. Read it before you send it.
supplier.nothingToSend: Nothing to send. Approved invoices don't need a supplier message.
supplier.noDraft: No supplier draft was written for this run. The reasoning at the top is for reviewers, not the supplier. If you dispute the line, write your message from the clauses above.

nextStep.title: Your next step

recover.title: Request a {{amount}} credit from {{supplier}}
recover.body: Copy the paragraph above into an email from your supplier mailbox, attach the invoice PDF, then record the credit in AP.

review.title: Hold {{amount}} and make the call
review.body: The agents couldn't settle this one. Read the clauses and the evidence that points the other way, then approve or dispute the line.

escalate.title: Hold {{amount}} and escalate
escalate.body: Don't pay or dispute this line yet. Send the escalation packet to the owner named in the dispute procedure.

approve.title: Release for payment
approve.body: The invoice reconciles to the contract and operations data. Nothing to recover.

fallback.title: Decide what to do with {{amount}}
fallback.body: Read the clauses and evidence above before acting.

nextStep.noSend: Caldova records the case. It doesn't send email or post approvals from this panel.

notRun.activeTitle: Agents are working on this invoice
notRun.activeBody: The case appears here once the run records a decision. Follow each expert's progress in Activity.
notRun.title: No decision yet
notRun.body: Running assurance sends this invoice to the cloud agent pipeline. Four experts check it against their sources, then Caldova records one decision: approve, review, recover or escalate.
notRun.whatYouGet: You'll get the verdict and amount, the clauses it rests on, evidence by source, a paragraph for the supplier when there's something to send, and your next step.
notRun.hint: Can take several minutes. You'll confirm first.

assurance.title: Assurance
assurance.detail: No governed decision has been recorded for this invoice yet.

runConfirm.title: Run assurance for {{number}}?
runConfirm.pipeline: This starts the cloud agent pipeline for {{supplier}}. Four experts gather evidence, then a decision is recorded. It can take several minutes, and you'll follow it in Activity.
runConfirm.reuse: If a run is already active for this invoice, Caldova reuses it instead of starting another. Each new run uses hosted agent capacity and may incur usage cost.
runConfirm.runNumber: This will be run {{number}}. Earlier runs stay in the run history.
